name: Production Studio Hub (Multi-Action Example)
author: Control-It Developer Team
subtitle: Comprehensive Multi-Action Example Module
descriptionText: A comprehensive example module demonstrating persistent network sessions, dynamic setup wizards, 8 diverse action types, parameter substitution {param}, dropdowns, toggles, numeric sliders, raw hex, OSC, MIDI, and JavaScript driver scripts.

setupFields.label: Host / IP Address
setupFields.helpText: Enter the IP address of your studio controller.

setupFields.label: Port
setupFields.helpText: Network port used by the studio API.

setupFields.label: API Key / Token
setupFields.helpText: Authentication token if required by your device.

variables.name: Active Program Scene
variables.descriptionText: Name of the active video scene

actions.title: Get System Status
actions.subtitle: Poll live device telemetry
actions.descriptionText: Performs an HTTP GET to retrieve real-time device health, current scene, and audio telemetry.

actions.title: Toggle System Power
actions.subtitle: Turn studio standby ON/OFF
actions.descriptionText: Sends a power state change to the device with a toggle input parameter.

actions.title: Select Video Input
actions.subtitle: Switch live camera source
actions.descriptionText: Switches the active video source on the broadcast switcher using a dropdown menu.

inputs.label: Camera Source
inputs.descriptionText: Select which camera input to send to Program.

actions.title: Set Master Audio Gain
actions.subtitle: Adjust audio level via OSC
actions.descriptionText: Sends an OSC message adjusting the main stereo fader.

actions.title: Send Stage Cue (MIDI)
actions.subtitle: Fire lighting cue note
actions.descriptionText: Transmits a MIDI Note On trigger to the lighting console.
